why: The creator after the berry fix (2026-10-14): "Sunny Castle is good enough. But still some flags we talked about before, like making all area reachable". The composed levels were made with nothing that joins their places: Sunny Castle's third island had no bridge. Here the world may only cut ramps (config/world.json reach.kinds ["ramp"]: a look with no bridge, sandbar or pad), and no ramp crosses 12 m of sea: the east island and the west island with the gatehouse on its hill are left across the water. Gate D must fail it on measure 6, naming each area, where it is and why.
